lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour. Same windows and method as w41b: m.py, c.py and d.py re-run as r41 vs r42 in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/799b632d-abc8-5982-a611-3a2c97f75011/scratchpad/raterB42/. Added h.py (q16 cover boxes, middle 70 % of L), t.py, b.py and b2.py (belt webbing masks, q17 right block x 470-930, y 250-575). Change fractions vs r41: q15 4.6 % (about half is the other workers' ceiling and carpet; econ changes are the covers, the side-block belts and the tucked tongues), q16 7.2 %, q17 0.73 %. In the studio: e7 4.4 %, e11 4.1 %, e1 2.3 % and e4b 2.1 % (all belts), e3 0.19 %, e10, e5 and e8 bit-identical, the rest under 0.1 %. Back, pillow and pan windows are identical to r41 to 0.1 L.

priorIssues.note: q16 cover boxes (middle 70 % of L): r41 L 39.2 / 54.8 / 28.9 / 44.0 -> r42 42.5 / 58.2 / 32.6 / 47.1 (+3.3 L), vs y_47301 57.6 / 69.1 / 100.9. Mean gap -34 -> -31 L. B/R 1.99-2.55, still bluer than the photo's 1.72-1.98. q15 head-on darkest 40 %: (36-38, 39-41, 70-73) L 46-48 -> (39-40, 42-44, 78-80) L 49-51, vs y_47300 L 37-65 (mean 47.6) and B/R 1.73-2.13. Still matched, and B/R 1.99 is inside the photo range. q17 is unchanged: a narrow pale strip against the photo's grey-blue flap.

Centre-block tucked belt: light-grey px 765 -> 725, vs photo 1015. The tongue moved 0.5 cm back, but the navy stubs and silver tongue still read under every q15 pillow, where y_47300 shows only the grey cover.

farA L>150 2.6 -> 2.7 % and farB 6.1 -> 6.1 %, vs photo 17.0 / 10.2 %. farB contrast 3.10 -> 2.91 (photo 3.21) and farA 2.51 -> 2.44. Only 1.1 % of the far window changed: the lighter covers (33,36,72) -> (36,40,81) soften the dark band.
e11 dark px (L<45) by 40-row band from y 200 is bit-identical to s41 (1120 / 6687 / 9324 / 9615 / 5461 / 1155 / 439).

details.refs: Held. q15 L 49-51 B/R 1.99 is still inside y_47300 (37-65 / 1.73-2.13). q16 gained only 3 L (gap -31).

Up 0.1. The side blocks now drape the belts as in y_47301 / y_47303: q17 right-block webbing-mask px 90 -> 680, and the q16 saturated-belt px 26 -> 949. e7's tongue (79,166,216) is close to y_47303's lit webbing (62-91, 123-145, 191-216). Held back because the straps stair-step (w42b-1), they read saturated royal blue in shadow (w42b-2), the q17 straps are short stubs where the photo's hang over the pan front, and the centre-block stubs remain.
Down 0.1: farB contrast 3.10 -> 2.91 (photo 3.21) and farA 2.51 -> 2.44, from the lighter covers. The highlight share is still 2.7 / 6.1 % vs 17.0 / 10.2 %.

issues.title: Draped straps stair-step across the pan
issues.evidence: The three gBox segments per strap are laid flat, with no pitch, at stepped panY heights. In e11 and e7 the navy buckle strap shows two visible risers (saw-tooth edges) between the rear crease and the latch. Real webbing lies smooth (y_47303).
issues.fix: Give each segment a pitch of atan(0.0875) (5 deg, front up) to follow panY, e.g. M4.trs(..., yaw) composed with rotX(-atan(0.0875)) along the strap direction. Or use one pitched box per strap with L = full length. Keep the +0.004 lift.

issues.title: Side-block belts read saturated royal blue in the shaded head-on and aisle views
issues.fix: Lower the chroma, not the lightness: yBelt '#2d5c90' -> '#3d6088' (B/R 2.2), or r 0.9 -> 0.75 so the cove sheen greys it. Re-check that q17 tongue stays G/R >= 1.6.

issues.title: q17 straps are short stubs; the photo's hang over the pan front
issues.evidence: q17 right-block webbing-mask px r42 680 (spread as 30-40 px stubs by the armrest), while y_47303 shows two 70-90 px straps with the buckle near the pan front edge.
issues.fix: Move the latch forward: z2 -0.33 -> -0.40 and x2 0.03 -> 0.06 (mid-pan latch nearer the front). Optionally drop the buckle-side end 2 cm over the front lip.

issues.title: Carried: q16 covers 31 L dark
issues.fix: As in w41b: widen the SHEEN lobe (lighting) so the 30-60 deg views lift. Changing the base colour alone cannot close the gap without breaking q15.

issues.title: Carried: centre-block navy stubs beside the buckle
Carried: far rows low highlight share; contrast slipped
issues.fix: Lift the far headrest-top tint toward '#5a6898'. Keep the far cover at the w41 (33,36,72) level.

issues.title: Carried: pillow a flat plaque
issues.fix: Pillow loft: corners out 1.5 cm, mid-edges pinched 1 cm, centre 1 cm thicker.

issues.title: Carried: fleck contrast low
issues.fix: Raise the fleck swatch gain about 10 % at the same mean.

issues.title: Carried: black edge under the pan front
issues.evidence: e11 dark bands identical to w41.

issues.title: Carried: near pans 6-16 L dark (not scored)
issues.fix: Lighting owner: check the low fill or AO at the q15 camera.
